_README: EGX market closures. This file is DATA, not code, because the exchange
publishes its calendar by announcement and the Islamic-calendar holidays
closures: ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) on which EGX does not trade. Only dates
that actually fall on a Sun-Thu day matter (weekend entries are
verified: false means the year has NOT been reconciled against EGX's own
published announcement. An unverified year is treated as
'no holidays exist' - silent under-fetching is the failure mode this flag
How to update: run `python scripts/egx_data_probe.py holidays --year YYYY`
to see what the calendar currently believes, then fill the moveable
Islamic dates (Eid al-Fitr ~3 days, Eid al-Adha ~4 days, Hijri New Year,
Mawlid) from the EGX announcement page and flip verified to true.

_fixed_date_national_holidays._note: These recur on the same Gregorian date every year; they are still listed per-year so an unverified year stays visibly unverified.
